hot_path.name: RunResidentRows
hot_path.source_reads: x and residual are consumed once per row
hot_path.resident_value: FP32 u=x+residual remains in one UB row
hot_path.precision: all intermediate math FP32; single cast to native dtype at output

generic_path.name: RunGenericRows
generic_path.coverage: FP16/BF16/FP32 and all legal rows and D
generic_path.precision: all intermediate math FP32; single cast to native dtype at output

v002_changes.dtype_mapping: kernel now uses judge contract 0=FP32,1=FP16,2=BF16 end-to-end; run_kernel passes info.dtype through unchanged
v002_changes.fp32_intermediate: u=x+residual and RMS/norm math all FP32; native cast only at output (was quantizing u to native before sum-of-squares)
v002_changes.bf16_fromfloat: fixed endian bug that returned low 16 bits instead of BF16 bits 31:16
v002_changes.resident_row: resident UB row is FP32 (4*dim bytes) so u is reused without native quantization
v002_changes.mode_dispatch: run_kernel selects mode 0 when 4*dim <= 160KiB else generic fallback
v002_changes.formula: output = (u / rms) * gamma + bias with rms = sqrt(mean(u*u)+eps)

submission.integration: G001 Child V002: FP32 intermediate, BF16 cast fix, judge dtype encoding
